name: deployr
description: A small Vercel-style deployment platform: clone, build, store on S3, serve.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix vercel install && npm --prefix vercel-deploy-service install && npm --prefix request-handler install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,worker,sites,ui -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm --prefix vercel run dev" "npm --prefix vercel-deploy-service run dev" "npm --prefix request-handler run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix vercel run build && npm --prefix vercel-deploy-service run build && npm --prefix request-handler run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,sites -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix vercel start" "npm --prefix vercel-deploy-service start" "npm --prefix request-handler start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix vercel run typecheck && npm --prefix vercel-deploy-service run typecheck && npm --prefix request-handler run typecheck
